title: Student Records Privacy
text: Staff may release directory information unless a student has requested confidentiality. Grades, schedules, and financial details are never released without the student's signed consent on form F-210, except to college officials with a legitimate need.

title: Student Records Privacy
text: Before discussing a record, verify identity with the student ID number and two of: date of birth, address on file, or last four digits of phone. Do not use Social Security numbers.

title: Refunds and Withdrawals
text: Students who drop a 16-week course in the first week receive a 100 percent refund. No refund is given after the first week. 8-week courses follow a shortened schedule in the academic calendar.

title: Refunds and Withdrawals
text: Refund exceptions for medical or military reasons require form F-330 and documentation, reviewed within 10 business days.

title: Late Registration
text: Late registration after the first class meeting requires instructor approval. After the first week, it also requires the department chair.

title: Late Registration
text: Updated: late registration after the first class meeting requires instructor approval through form F-115. After the first week, it is not allowed except for 8-week second-half courses.

title: Accessibility Accommodations
text: Refer students to Disability Support Services. Staff must not ask about a diagnosis. Accommodation letters are sent to instructors by DSS.

title: Emergency Grants
text: Currently enrolled students facing an unexpected expense of up to 500.00 may apply once per term using form F-520.

title: Emergency Grants
text: At the Indianapolis campus, emergency grants up to 750.00 are available through June 2027 under a pilot program.

title: Front Desk Service Standards
text: Answer phone calls within three rings. Respond to emails within one business day. Escalate unresolved issues to a supervisor after 48 hours.

title: Front Desk Service Standards
text: Check in walk-in students using the queue system and give an estimated wait time.
